label: Test local joining when every stage has a source but its relay chain continues (inference)
rule: Construct upstream joins by parity and prove acyclicity by strict stage order
meaning: Each relay stage has both an immediate source and a further relay. Sources alternate, so the further relay reaches the initial source through one more relay. Opposite sources have no common extension. This tests substituting a short route to some source for well-foundedness in the local-fork argument.
